answer.summary: Issue reports inability to load the JourneyDB dataset, with a FileNotFoundError; comments identify gated access and unsupported .tgz data-file structure.
Issue reports that loading a locally modified cached dataset with load_dataset unexpectedly redownloads the original dataset.
Requests saving a dataset into a specified number of shards, potentially using multiprocessing.
The TREC dataset implementation has 47 fine classes instead of the documented 50 because labels are merged across coarse classes.
Documentation for the main branch is no longer being built; only release documentation is triggered.
Loading the billsum dataset fails with a checksum mismatch for its Google Drive source file.
Issue asks whether datasets supports reading raw text data from HDFS.
Issue labeled only "streaming"; it reports a column rename/remove interaction in IterableDataset.
The issue reports an import failure caused by the reporter’s environment; they later identified the environmental dependency as the cause.
The issue asks whether the fs= argument should be deprecated in load_from_disk(); it has no official labels and was closed by PR #5393.
Reports a GLIBC 2.27 compatibility problem on Ubuntu 18, with a traceback during a Transformers dataset example.
Feature request for documentation and guidance on distributed data-parallel training with streaming datasets.
The issue reports that the rvl_cdip dataset could not be loaded; no official labels are present.
The issue reports an ImportError when loading the seqeval metric because the seqeval dependency is not installed.
Reports excessive memory use when to_tf_dataset shuffles large datasets; no official labels are present.
Importing datasets installed via conda causes an illegal instruction crash, apparently on AMD Opteron 8384 processors.
Issue reports a FileNotFoundError when loading a dataset with multiple builder configurations; no official labels are present.
Issue reports unexpected temporary-directory behavior when TMPDIR is changed at runtime after tempfile is imported.
Request to add IWSLT15+ and ITTB datasets; comments discuss dataset-loading guidance and broken download URLs for most IWSLT language pairs.
Release 2.5.0 breaks the Transformers CI, with a proposed revert of PR #4971.
Reports that Hugging Face’s Git server returns a null Content-Type after pushing dataset changes instead of application/x-git-receive-pack-result.
The map cache fails to detect changes to functions defined in another module. It was closed as a duplicate, attributed to a dill serialization limitation.
Issue reports that load_dataset fails to load a dataset saved with save_to_disk due to inconsistent format inference across splits.
Issue reports inability to view the split data for the LawalAfeez/englishreview-ds-mini dataset; a comment states it was currently working.
Duplicate citation, homepage, and license fields occur after map with num_proc > 1, likely due to repeated concatenation.
Issue reports a connection error when loading a local CSV; comments indicate intermittent network access to raw.githubusercontent.com was the cause.
Issue reports that ROUGE metric scores vary across repeated runs with identical predictions and references.
The issue reports inconsistent behavior when using map() to incrementally modify nested dictionary features.
The dataset unique() call fails with ArrowNotImplementedError for list<string> columns in datasets 2.0.0.
Issue reports a KeyError on 'lastCommit' when loading Hugging Face datasets; no official labels are present.
Issue discusses resolving dataset data files into splits based on filenames or paths; no official labels are present.
GPU-trained Faiss indexes fail to save because the GPU index type cannot be serialized.
The issue reports that caching cannot be disabled or cleaned, causing excessive storage usage; no official labels are present.
Reports excessive RAM usage when loading large Parquet datasets on a ZFS pool; labels contain no bug, enhancement, or question classification.
Users report being unable to download the cnn_dailymail dataset, resulting in a NotADirectoryError.
Requests adding task tags for multimodal, image, and video datasets; the issue was closed after the Hub began supporting multimodal tasks.
Issue reports an IndexError during T5-small training on the SQuAD dataset; comments indicate a Transformers fix and closing.
Issue reports an incorrect AttributeError when loading the GLUE dataset without specifying a configuration name.
Issue reports load_dataset hanging on Debian 10 and server clusters, while working on laptops; comments suggest file locking or filesystem configuration issues.
Different MP3 decoding results between torchaudio versions produce tensors with differing lengths and values, affecting integrations.
Requests updating audio installation documentation to reflect torchaudio versions above 0.12 and required FFmpeg setup.
Requests more specific DataFilesNotFoundError details identifying configurations with missing or unsupported data files.
The dataset viewer is blank for the specified offenseval_2020 and polstance datasets; comments attribute this to backend load and queued processing.
Issue reports a TypeError when calling nlp.load_dataset(); no official labels are present.
Issue reports inability to download dataset_info.json on a server without external internet access.
Issue reports that The Pile dataset feature specification does not match the actual data structures across configurations.
Issue reports that the turkish_product_reviews dataset has incorrect sentiment labels; all reviews were labeled positive.
Issue reports a NonMatchingChecksumError for the LinCE lid_msaea dataset after a data update and asks how to update the checksum.
Dataset speech_commands is missing from the Hub’s speech-processing task search despite having apparently correct task tags.
Issue concerns a dataset viewer for yanekyuk/wikikey; the official label is dataset-viewer, so it does not match bug, enhancement, or question.
Reports transform fingerprint collisions when fixed random seeds cause incorrect cache files to load; proposes using uuid.uuid4().
Request to add original sentence IDs and related metadata to the OpenSubtitles corpus.
Issue reports load_dataset() failure for the_pile’s enron_emails subset; no official labels are present.
The issue requests adding the ObjectFolder 2.0 dataset. Its official label is “dataset request,” and a comment says datasets are no longer tracked here.
CI fails on Windows for the sari and wiki_split metrics tests.
Feature request to add a num_proc parameter to load_from_disk for faster concurrent loading of large datasets.
Reports a ValueError when loading the ccdv/cnn_dailymail dataset in the Chapter 6 notebook. No official labels or public comments are present.
Requests a way for customized loading scripts to return a Dataset directly instead of a single-entry DatasetDict.
Reports a checksum mismatch when loading the lc_quad dataset; comments mention a fix PR and a workaround to rebuild from source.
Issue reports extreme slowdown and possible OOM when dataset.map returns grayscale images shaped (H,W,1).
Issue reports that combining cast_column, remove_columns, and map operations can cause add_faiss_index to raise a ValueError.
Feature request to support DEFAULT_CONFIG_NAME when BUILDER_CONFIGS is undefined, enabling on-the-fly named configurations.

Requests adding a core maintainer list to CONTRIBUTING.md.

Issue reports that tokenization with 48 workers is taking too long. No official labels are present.

The ToTTo dataset cannot be downloaded because its data source URL changed.
Issue reports a 403 error while uploading a dataset to the Hub; a later comment says it appears resolved, possibly due to the university network.
Dataset loading fails with a TypeError because _download_and_prepare() receives an unexpected verify_infos argument.
No official labels are present. The issue reports Dataloader getitem failing for DreamboothDatasets and says moving to Datasets 2.8.0 resolved it.

Issue reports a DuplicatedKeysError when loading a personal dataset; the official label is bug.
The issue reports dataset.map() freezing on the ELI5 dataset; comments identify a pyarrow overflow and empty-list type inference problem.

Issue reports trailing whitespace in the riddle_sense dataset code, flagged by flake8.
